sources.title: DOE Geothermal Energy from Mechanisms of Subsurface Systems (GEMS) challenge overview
sources.session_status: Verified in the 2026-10-09 review: fetched 2026-10-09 (chunks 0 and 1 of 2). Verbatim: 'Your submission has the same bounds as the training data, and data outside the bounds is null or nan.'; 'a single layer with datatype of 32-bit float (float32) with values between 0 and 1'; EPSG 32611; 100 m. Metric: distance-weighted Tversky, alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, triangular kernel R = 300 m; worked example TP 3.00, FP 1.89, FN 2.00 gives 0.60. Two rounds: initial prize on a private test set; final prize rescored on expanded labels.
